ar: هل تحب المدرسة؟ أم تعتقد أن المدرسة مملة؟ ربما تريد الذهاب إلى مدرسة مختلفة.
en: Do you like school? Or do you think school is boring? Maybe you want to go to a different kind of school.
questions: Do all students like school?
Can school be different?

ar: في الأرجنتين، توجد مدرسة داخل ملعب كرة قدم كبير.
en: In Argentina, one school is inside a large soccer stadium.
questions: Where is the school in Argentina located?
Is it a normal school building?

ar: أكثر من 70 ألف شخص يمكنهم مشاهدة المباريات في هذا الملعب.
en: More than 70,000 people can watch games in this stadium.
questions: How many people can watch games in the stadium?
Is the stadium big or small?

ar: في بنغلاديش، هناك مدارس خاصة على القوارب بسبب الفيضانات.
en: In Bangladesh, there are special schools on boats because of floods.
questions: Why are there boat schools in Bangladesh?
Do students travel by boat?

ar: الطلاب يدرسون على القوارب ويجلسون على مقاعد خشبية.
en: Students study on boats and sit on wooden benches.
questions: Where do students sit in boat schools?
Is the classroom on land or water?

ar: في مدرسة الجبال في فيرمونت، يعيش الطلاب في المدرسة ويعملون في المزرعة.
en: At the Mountain School in Vermont, students live at the school and work on a farm.
questions: Where is the Mountain School?
Do students live at this school?

ar: الطلاب يزرعون الطعام ويربون الحيوانات ويساعدون في تنظيف المدرسة.
en: Students grow food, feed animals, and help clean the school.
questions: What do students do at the farm?
Do they only study or also work?

ar: في مدرسة بروكلين الحرة، لا توجد اختبارات أو واجبات أو درجات.
en: At Brooklyn Free School, there are no tests, homework, or grades.
questions: Are there exams in Brooklyn Free School?
Do students get grades?

ar: يمكن للطلاب اختيار الدروس واتخاذ قرارات مهمة بأنفسهم.
en: Students can choose classes and make important decisions themselves.
questions: Can students choose their classes?
Do students have control in this school?

ar: هل هناك شيء غير عادي في مدرستك؟ ولماذا هي مميزة؟
en: Is there anything unusual about your school? Why is it special?
questions: What is the final question about?
Is this a personal reflection question?
